Name: (AT) Initial Farmhouse Reverse
Author: Ordospoo
Description:
Makes upgraded farmhouses look like the original pre-upgrade farmhouse using Alternative Textures.

For those who loves the rural aesthetic of the initial farmhouse!

Simply change the exterior appearance of your farmhouse by using the paint bucket (a feature of the AT framework) purchased from Robin.
